questions.question_english: According to Section 22 of the Right to Education Act, 2009, which entity holds the primary responsibility for preparing and recommending the School Development Plan (SDP)?

The Regional Directorate of Education
The Head of School or Principal independently

questions.explanation_english: Under Section 22 of the Right to Education Act, the School Management Committee is assigned the statutory responsibility of preparing and recommending the School Development Plan. This committee synthesizes institutional needs, infrastructure requirements, and learning resource estimates. The resulting plan forms the operational basis for government grant allocations and systemic school infrastructure enhancements.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। आरटीई अधिनियम की धारा 22 के तहत, स्कूल प्रबंधन समिति को स्कूल विकास योजना (एसडीपी) तैयार करने और सिफारिश करने की वैधानिक जिम्मेदारी दी गई है। यह समिति संस्थागत आवश्यकताओं, बुनियादी ढांचे की आवश्यकताओं और शिक्षण संसाधनों के अनुमान को एकीकृत करती है। परिणामस्वरूप तैयार की गई योजना सरकारी अनुदान आवंटन और प्रणालीगत स्कूल बुनियादी ढांचे में सुधार के लिए संचालनात्मक आधार बनाती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) School Management Committee

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Section 22 of the Right to Education Act, the School Management Committee is assigned the statutory responsibility of preparing and recommending the School Development Plan.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the maintenance of a Stock Register in a school:
I. Consumable and non-consumable articles should ideally be maintained in separate stock registers.
II. Physical verification of all non-consumable stock must be done at least once a year.
III. Obsolete items can be discarded directly by the Store In-charge without formal write-off approval.
IV. The Head of the Institution must sign the certificate of physical verification.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II and III
I, II and IV
II, III and IV
I, III and IV
questions.explanation_english: Stock registers mandate distinct classification between consumable materials and durable, non-consumable assets for proper financial accounting. Annual physical verification of non-consumable items must be conducted, and the institutional head must sign the verification certificate to confirm store accuracy. Unserviceable or obsolete items cannot be arbitrarily discarded by storekeepers without formal authorization and written write-off procedures.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। स्टॉक रजिस्टर उपभोग्य सामग्रियों और टिकाऊ, गैर-उपभोग्य संपत्तियों के बीच स्पष्ट वर्गीकरण की मांग करते हैं ताकि वित्तीय लेखांकन सही हो सके। गैर-उपभोग्य वस्तुओं का वार्षिक भौतिक सत्यापन किया जाना चाहिए, और संस्थान के प्रमुख को स्टोर की सटीकता की पुष्टि करने के लिए सत्यापन प्रमाण पत्र पर हस्ताक्षर करना चाहिए। अनुपयोगी या पुरानी वस्तुओं को स्टोरकिपर्स द्वारा औपचारिक प्राधिकरण और लिखित लिखने की प्रक्रियाओं के बिना मनमाने ढंग से नहीं नष्ट किया जा सकता।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I, II and IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Stock registers mandate distinct classification between consumable materials and durable, non-consumable assets for proper financial accounting.

questions.question_english: Which group decision-making technique relies on a panel of experts who anonymously respond to questionnaires and subsequently receive feedback in the form of a statistical representation of the 'group response,' aiming for consensus over multiple rounds?

Nominal Group Technique
Delphi Technique

questions.explanation_english: The Delphi Technique is a structured consensus-building method that gathers judgments from a panel of experts through multiple rounds of anonymous questionnaires. This technique reaches informed consensus on complex planning issues.

questions.question_english:
The primary objective of conducting a 360-degree appraisal for a teacher is to:
Gather comprehensive feedback from superiors, peers, students, and self.
options_english: Gather comprehensive feedback from superiors, peers, students, and self
Restrict the performance evaluation solely to the Head Teacher’s personal classroom observations
Assess the teacher’s broad geographical knowledge and regional background details
Determine the exact annual financial budget allocated for the teacher’s academic department
questions.explanation_english: A 360-degree appraisal gathers performance feedback from multiple stakeholders, including administrative supervisors, colleagues, subordinate staff, students, and self-evaluations. This multi-source evaluation offers a holistic view of professional competencies, interpersonal skills, and classroom effectiveness. By minimizing individual evaluator bias, it provides actionable insights that support structured professional development for educators.

questions.question_hindi: एक एसएमसी बैठक के दौरान, माता-पिता के प्रतिनिधियों और प्रधान के बीच विद्यालय रखरखाव अनुदान के उपयोग को लेकर गंभीर असहमति उत्पन्न होती है। माता-पिता इसे नए खेल के मैदान के शेड के लिए उपयोग करना चाहते हैं, जबकि प्रधान का कहना है कि इसे विज्ञान ब्लॉक की लीक हो रही छत की मरम्मत के लिए उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए। यदि प्रधान अपनी शक्ति का उपयोग करके माता-पिता की मांग को एकतरफा रूप से अस्वीकार करते हैं और सुरक्षा चिंताओं के कारण तुरंत छत की मरम्मत करते हैं, तो वह किस संघर्ष प्रबंधन शैली का प्रयोग कर रहे हैं?
options_hindi: समायोजन करना
टालना
समझौता करना
प्रतिस्पर्धा करना

questions.question_english: During an SMC meeting, a severe disagreement arises between the parent representatives and the Principal regarding the utilization of the school maintenance grant. The parents want it used for a new playground shed, while the Principal insists it must go toward repairing a leaking roof in the science block. If the Principal uses his authority to unilaterally veto the parents’ demand and execute the roof repair immediately due to safety concerns, which conflict management style is he exercising?
options_english: Accommodating
Avoiding
Compromising
Competing
questions.explanation_english: Competing is an assertive, non-cooperative conflict management style where an individual pursues their own concerns at the expense of others, using formal authority or positional power to enforce decisions. When a school head unilaterally overrules stakeholder preferences to execute an urgent safety intervention, they employ a competing style to ensure decisive action.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। प्रतिस्पर्धा करना एक आत्मविश्वासी, गैर-सहयोगी संघर्ष प्रबंधन शैली है जहाँ एक व्यक्ति दूसरों की कीमत पर अपनी चिंताओं का पीछा करता है, औपचारिक अधिकार या पद शक्ति का उपयोग करके निर्णय लागू करता है। जब एक विद्यालय प्रमुख एकतरफा रूप से हितधारकों की प्राथमिकताओं को अस्वीकार करता है ताकि एक तात्कालिक सुरक्षा हस्तक्षेप को लागू किया जा सके, तो वह निर्णायक कार्रवाई सुनिश्चित करने के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करने की शैली का उपयोग करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Competing

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Competing is an assertive, non-cooperative conflict management style where an individual pursues their own concerns at the expense of others, using formal authority or positional power to enforce decisions.

questions.question_english: The Ishikawa diagram, commonly referred to as the Fishbone diagram, is primarily utilized in educational management for:
options_english: Master time-table construction and scheduling
Calculating annual institutional financial budgets
Mapping the administrative scalar chain of command
Root cause problem analysis
questions.explanation_english: The Ishikawa diagram, commonly called a fishbone diagram, is a structured analytical tool used in quality management to identify and categorize potential causes of a specific problem. By systematically mapping contributing factors across categories such as methods, equipment, and personnel, administrators isolate root causes to formulate targeted corrective interventions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। इशिकावा आरेख, जिसे मछली की हड्डी आरेख कहा जाता है, एक संरचित विश्लेषणात्मक उपकरण है जिसका उपयोग गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन में किसी विशिष्ट समस्या के संभावित कारणों की पहचान और वर्गीकरण के लिए किया जाता है। यह विधियों, उपकरणों और कर्मियों जैसी श्रेणियों में योगदान देने वाले कारकों को व्यवस्थित रूप से मानचित्रित करके, प्रशासक मूल कारणों को अलग करते हैं ताकि लक्षित सुधारात्मक हस्तक्षेप तैयार किए जा सकें।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Root cause problem analysis

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Ishikawa diagram, commonly called a fishbone diagram, is a structured analytical tool used in quality management to identify and categorize potential causes of a specific problem.

questions.question_english: Frederick Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory distinguishes between ‘Hygiene factors’ and ‘Motivators’. In a school environment, which of the following would be considered a ‘Motivator’ rather than a ‘Hygiene factor’?
options_english: Base salary and financial compensation of the teacher
General cleanliness and physical condition of the staff room
Recognition for teaching performance
Overall institutional policies and administrative oversight
questions.explanation_english: Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory categorizes workplace factors into Hygiene factors and Motivators. Hygiene factors, such as working conditions, administrative policies, and basic salary, prevent dissatisfaction but do not inherently motivate. Motivators, including achievement, intrinsic work interest, and recognition for performance, actively drive job satisfaction and higher performance by addressing higher-level psychological growth needs within personnel.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। हर्ज़बर्ग का दो-कारक सिद्धांत कार्यस्थल के कारकों को हाइजीन कारकों और प्रेरक कारकों में वर्गीकृत करता है। हाइजीन कारक, जैसे कार्य की स्थिति, प्रशासनिक नीतियाँ, और मूल वेतन, असंतोष को रोकते हैं लेकिन स्वाभाविक रूप से प्रेरित नहीं करते। प्रेरक कारक, जैसे उपलब्धि, आंतरिक कार्य रुचि, और प्रदर्शन के लिए मान्यता, नौकरी की संतोषजनकता और उच्च प्रदर्शन को सक्रिय रूप से बढ़ावा देते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Recognition for teaching performance
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory categorizes workplace factors into Hygiene factors and Motivators.

questions.question_english: Kurt Lewin's foundational model for change management is divided into three stages. What is the correct sequence of these stages?

Unfreeze, Change, Refreeze
Initiate, Develop, Standardise
Freeze, Change, Unfreeze
questions.explanation_english: Kurt Lewin’s Change Management Model consists of three sequential stages: Unfreeze, Change, and Refreeze. Unfreezing involves preparing the organization to dismantle existing mindsets and status quo operations. The Change stage introduces new behaviors, structures, or methodologies. Refreezing stabilizes and embeds these continuous operational changes into organizational culture to ensure long-term sustainability.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। कर्ट लेविन का परिवर्तन प्रबंधन मॉडल तीन अनुक्रमिक चरणों में विभाजित है: अनफ्रीज, परिवर्तन, और रीफ्रीज। अनफ्रीजिंग का अर्थ है संगठन को मौजूदा मानसिकताओं और स्थिति को समाप्त करने के लिए तैयार करना। परिवर्तन चरण में नए व्यवहार, संरचनाएँ, या विधियाँ पेश की जाती हैं। रीफ्रीजिंग इन निरंतर परिचालन परिवर्तनों को संगठनात्मक संस्कृति में स्थिर और समाहित करता है ताकि दीर्घकालिक स्थिरता सुनिश्चित की जा सके।

The following are two statements: one is labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R). 
Assertion (A): According to Maslow, a teacher will not be highly motivated by self-actualization needs if their basic physiological and safety needs are severely threatened. 
Reason (R): Maslow’s theory postulates that higher-order needs only become dominant motivators after lower-order needs are relatively satisfied.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A

questions.explanation_english: Maslow’s theory posits that human needs are arranged in a strict hierarchy, where lower-order physiological and safety needs must be satisfied before higher-level growth needs become active motivators. When basic survival or employment security is severely threatened, individuals prioritize safety, rendering higher-order needs like self-actualization temporarily secondary in driving personal motivation.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। मास्लो का सिद्धांत यह बताता है कि मानव आवश्यकताएँ एक सख्त पदानुक्रम में व्यवस्थित होती हैं, जहाँ निम्न-क्रम की शारीरिक और सुरक्षा आवश्यकताओं को संतुष्ट करना आवश्यक है इससे पहले कि उच्च-क्रम की विकास आवश्यकताएँ सक्रिय प्रेरक बनें। जब मूल अस्तित्व या रोजगार सुरक्षा गंभीर रूप से खतरे में होती है, तो व्यक्ति सुरक्षा को प्राथमिकता देते हैं, जिससे आत्म-साक्षात्कार जैसी उच्च-क्रम की आवश्यकताएँ व्यक्तिगत प्रेरणा को चलाने में अस्थायी रूप से द्वितीयक हो जाती हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Maslow’s theory posits that human needs are arranged in a strict hierarchy, where lower-order physiological and safety needs must be satisfied before higher-level growth needs become active motivators.
